verdict.rationale: Salesforce's own pages describe AI-powered insights for reps, built into Sales Cloud. Named features include AI-generated lead scoring shown inside the CRM view, Predictive Forecasting, and surfacing pipeline and opportunity insights, so the core story is delivered. The evidence is marketing-level only, and nothing beyond lead scoring and forecasting shows in-product suggestions. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how insights and recommendations are generated and surfaced, evidence of actionable next-step suggestions beyond scoring and forecasting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
